name: Platform API
description: The local platform service (#508): the core, idea, platform, prompt and intake data in one SQLite file, served on 127.0.0.1:8400 behind the /auth/v1 and /rest/v1 subset the Shell, Brain, broker, llm-handler and tools already call, with single-owner ES256 auth. Replaces the Supabase platform project (owner decision 2026-10-29: local-only).
